summary: Registrant filed a Form 8-K reporting regular monthly distributions declared May 1, 2026 for Class I ($0.1875/share) and Class S ($0.1875 gross, net ~$0.1704 after fees) shares payable June 29, 2026 to holders of record May 31, 2026, plus portfolio commentary (458 companies, ~$10B fair value, 96% first lien, 1.21x leverage). No merger, acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC event, or forced management change is presented. This is a routine periodic disclosure of distributions and portfolio update, not a special situation.
